source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary: As your Movement phase begins, choose one option. Defensive Footing: pick one objective you control as your Vowed objective, lasting until your following Movement phase begins. Aggressive Push: pick one or more objectives not under your control, each becoming a Vowed objective of yours for the same length of time, and a rule that refers to being in range of the Vowed objective applies when the unit or model is in range of at least one of them. Attacks made by DEATHWING INFANTRY units of yours against a unit in range of any of your Vowed objectives get +1 to their Wound rolls.

Defensive Footing.vowedUntil: start of your next Movement phase

Aggressive Push.vowedUntil: start of your next Movement phase

effect.targetCondition: target unit within range of one or more Vowed objectives

cardPrintsOtherText.armyRestriction: DARK ANGELS units only, no ADEPTUS ASTARTES units from another Chapter
